kjv: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not (KJV 77:2)
mine: in the night my hand is stretched out without wearying
note: yadi laylah niggerah "my hand was poured out/stretched out by night" in prayer; the KJV reads yad as a running "sore".

kjv: This [is] my infirmity: [but I will remember] the years of the right hand of the most High (KJV 77:10)
mine: This is my grief: that the right hand of the Most High has changed
note: shenot can be "years" or the infinitive "changing" (shanah II): the psalmist's anguish is that God's right hand has changed; the KJV, with italic insertions, turns it into a resolve to remember better years.
